newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos backs probe into Manila banks forex deals.
newsitem.headline: Ramos backs probe into Manila banks forex deals.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos on Tuesday backed a move by the central bank to probe and punish banks which may have been involved in currency manipulation in the days before it was effectively devalued.
The central bank said on Monday it had started auditing the books of banks to find out if any of them had oversold or overbought positions beyond the permissible limits.
Last Friday, the peso was effectively devalued after the central bank said it would allow it to trade in a wider range.
"I call this announced probe very timely and appropriate," Ramos told a news conference in the remote southern island of Tawi Tawi which was broadcast live on government radio in Manila.

"As the representative of the majority of the Filipinos - meaning the consumers, the concerned citizenry, we must know whether or not local banks are getting involved in manipulation of this kind...," he said.
Central bank governor Gabriel Singson said sanctions would be imposed on those banks which may have bought dollars beyond the limits.
